name: Being Beauteous
source:
Once upon a time, in a far away kingdom, there was a young woman bullied by her evil step-mother and her step-sisters. It is said that her Fairy Godmother helped her to marry a prince and that they lived rich, happily ever after and had a lot of children. Or maybe it was a lie and the story didn’t go as you would have expected…

(Kinetic novel originally created in less than a week.)
